statements.query: MATCH ((n:AzureVirtualMachine)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (rule:AzureNetworkSecurityRule)<-[:CONTAIN]-(:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_NETWORK_SECURITY_GROUP]-(:AzureNetworkInterface)<-[:MEMBER_NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(vm:AzureVirtualMachine{power_state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE rule.access = 'Allow' AND rule.direction = 'Inbound' AND (rule.source_address_prefix IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', 'Internet'] OR any(p IN coalesce(rule.source_address_prefixes, []) WHERE p IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', 'Internet'])) SET vm.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_ipv4' IN coalesce(vm.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN vm END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(vm.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'direct_ipv4';

MATCH (:AzurePublicIPAddress)<-[:MEMBER_PUBLIC_IP_ADDRESS]-(:AzureLoadBalancerFrontendIPConfiguration)<-[:HAS]-(:AzureNetworkLoadBalancer)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(:AzureNetworkInterface)<-[:MEMBER_NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(vm:AzureVirtualMachine{power_state: 'running'})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET vm.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_load_balancer' IN coalesce(vm.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN vm END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(vm.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_load_balancer';

MATCH (vm:AzureVirtualMachine)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureSubscription{id: $AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AzureTenant{id: $AZURE_TENANT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE vm.exposed_internet = true WITH vm OPTIONAL MATCH (pip:AzurePublicIPAddress)<-[:MEMBER_PUBLIC_IP_ADDRESS]-(nic:AzureNetworkInterface)<-[:MEMBER_NETWORK_INTERFACE]-(vm) OPTIONAL MATCH (rule:AzureNetworkSecurityRule)<-[:CONTAIN]-(nsg:AzureNetworkSecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_NETWORK_SECURITY_GROUP]-(nic) WHERE rule.access = 'Allow' AND rule.direction = 'Inbound' AND (rule.source_address_prefix IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', '::/0', 'Internet'] OR any(p IN coalesce(rule.source_address_prefixes, []) WHERE p IN ['*', '0.0.0.0/0', '::/0', 'Internet'])) WITH vm, pip, nic, collect(DISTINCT {nsgId: nsg.id, ruleId: rule.id, port: rule.destination_port_range, protocol: rule.protocol, sourcePrefix: rule.source_address_prefix, sourcePrefixes: rule.source_address_prefixes, priority: rule.priority}) as nsgRules SET vm.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: vm.id, resourceType: 'azure-compute-virtualmachine', context: [{vmId: vm.id, vmName: vm.name, vmSize: vm.vm_size, osType: vm.os_type, publicIp: pip.ip_address, privateIp: nic.private_ip_address, exposureTypes: vm.exposed_internet_type, nsgRules: nsgRules, location: vm.location}]}])
